label: Diagram 9.3
caption: Diagram 9.3 Fire resisting ceiling below cavity
description: The drawing is a simple vertical section diagram. At the top left it reads "See para 9.5". A horizontal grey bar is labelled "Floor or roof above". Beneath it is an empty gap labelled "Cavity". Below the cavity is a horizontal line representing the ceiling, with the label "Ceiling" at its left end. A small tick marks the upper face of this line, labelled "Ceiling surface/product exposed to cavity – class C-s3, d2 or better". A second tick marks the lower face, labelled "Soffit of ceiling – class B-s3, d2 or better". To the right of the section is a text block headed "NOTE:" stating the ceiling should meet all of the following conditions: a. Provide a minimum fire resistance of EI 30. b. Be imperforate, except for an opening described in paragraph 9.17. c. Extend throughout the building or compartment. d. Not be easily demountable. A green banner along the bottom reads "Diagram 9.3 Fire resisting ceiling below cavity".
